findings.title: Repacking an existing ZIP retains obsolete entries
findings.releaseBlockingReason: Fresh canonical destinations avoid the demonstrated local repeat-packaging trigger; no corrupted published archive was established.
findings.reproduction: Pack two synthetic files, remove one, change/add content, repack into the same path, and compare with a fresh ZIP. Inject a partial failed ZIP writer and compare the previous destination bytes.
findings.expected: Only current staged content, with the previous archive preserved on failure.
findings.observed: The original ZIP add/update retained absent old entries and a failed writer overwrote the previous destination.
findings.impact: Stale or incomplete local repeat-package payload; no demonstrated secret compromise.
findings.recommendedFix: Fresh sibling temporary ZIP, explicit failure propagation and rename only after success.
findings.requiredVerification: Literal member/content and fresh-byte controls, failure preservation, existing umasks and independent review.

findings.title: Non-object browser options silently select defaults
findings.reproduction: Pass a number/boolean/string/symbol/bigint/function/array/null into optional-options public methods; make(42) reaches the worker rather than TypeError.
findings.expected: Omitted/undefined options remain defaults; supplied invalid container shapes reject before work.
findings.observed: The original shared guard skipped nonobjects and destructuring silently selected defaults.
findings.impact: Unexpected generation/check work from malformed caller configuration.
findings.recommendedFix: Validate the container once in the shared guard before key enumeration/default destructuring.
findings.requiredVerification: Nine optional-options families, eight invalid shapes, zero-worker assertions, omission/undefined/empty-record positives and real-browser regressions.

findings.title: Follow-up: browser wishes are collected before count refusal
findings.reproduction: Give an oversized chosen/excluded array with a throwing first-entry getter to describeDraw/drawPhrase.
findings.expected: Refuse count before entry access, framing, encoding or workers; preserve established public diagnostic sentences.
findings.observed: The original page traversed/framed every invalid entry before the Rust count guard.
findings.impact: Caller-controlled local work/copies before refusal; no measured OOM, remote attack or secret exposure.
findings.recommendedFix: Synchronous explicit count/type admission and bounded indexed traversal; preserve existing message adaptation.
findings.requiredVerification: Max+1 and 4096-entry getter controls, malformed lengths, overridden collection methods, scalar-copy damage controls, independent literal messages, Node and both browsers.
findings.history: Original ID retained. Native/raw fixes remain source-confirmed separately; this record addresses the demonstrated browser continuation.

findings.title: Erasure guidance retains the former phrase-text refusal code
findings.reproduction: Compare new raw admission INVALID_REQUEST wording with obsolete INVALID_PASSWORD_TEXT wording for readPhrase.
findings.expected: Distinguish raw phrase/container admission from direct secret-string encoding.
findings.observed: The same supported path was described with incompatible refusal codes.
findings.impact: Incorrect host error guidance, not a new runtime leak.
findings.recommendedFix: Correct the guides and specific declaration against their current callers.
findings.requiredVerification: Exact changed-document/caller review, type/format gates and independent review.

findings.title: Retry guidance omits retained failed self-check components
findings.reproduction: Compare unconditional retry-after-worker-error statements with the completed-failure latch.
findings.expected: Operational errors remain retryable only before any failed component closes the class.
findings.observed: Old wording omitted the earlier failure condition and contradicted the retained-failure policy.
findings.impact: Incorrect host recovery guidance; no implementation bypass established.
findings.recommendedFix: Qualify related guide/declaration/comment wording without changing the failure latch.
findings.requiredVerification: Current caller and checkpoint controls, changed-document review and independent acceptance.

findings.title: Oversized reference documents lack explicit whole-file exceptions
findings.reproduction: Baseline files have 1295/1138/2650 lines with no first-line reason and are not read by the length gate.
findings.expected: A justified whole-file exception or coherent restructuring, not an inferred pass.
findings.observed: The explicit exception documentation was absent.
findings.recommendedFix: State the stable API reference, standalone shipped README and complete redistribution-catalog reasons explicitly.
findings.requiredVerification: Independent whole-file rationale judgment, exact unchanged-body checks and preserved licence bodies; no gate relaxation.
